source_selection: primary focal creep or stress-rupture study with lawful stable PDF
explicit specimen identity, processing state, applied stress and test temperature
reported time units and numerical table or supplementary data for series points
independently reviewed ownership, evidence locator and checksum before activation
scientific_boundaries: one stress-temperature-specimen pair per test record; do not merge curves
a printed minimum creep rate is a reported derived metric, not a new direct measurement
a calculated rate from a curve is not admitted as reported source data
a creep strain-time point requires source_table or supplementary_data series provenance
figure-only traces are not canonical numerical points without a separate digitization workflow
no rupture time is inferred from a censored or stopped test
cited or review comparison data are quarantined from focal experiments
